use.flag: Build and install the Mojo debugger stack (mojo-lldb, libMojoLLDB, lldb-server); required for the "mojo debug" and "mojo repl" subcommands
Build the Mojo Jupyter kernel (libMojoJupyter and kernelspec); requires dev-python/jupyter-client at runtime

pkgmetadata.longdescription: The Mojo programming language: compiler (KGEN), standard library, language server, and REPL support, built from the open-source sources in the modular/modular repository. The compiler and its bundled LLVM/MLIR are compiled from source with Bazel; no prebuilt Mojo or MAX binaries are installed.
